name: LateGarbage
description: Garbage still on the heap at dump time: dead ConditionalWeakTable entries whose dependent handles are still registered, and objects reachable only through WeakReference.
notes: All three types are present (N each) but none is reachable from a retaining root. A loader that roots dependent-handle secondaries, adds edges from dead primaries, or treats weak handles as retaining gets this wrong.
